lines.text: The Valley of Vision's people go up to the rooftops, and its rulers flee together and are captured without a bow.
The prophet weeps bitterly over his people's destruction, because the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling.
Elam takes up a quiver and Assyria uncovers the shield, and horsemen are posted at the gates.
The people look to the weapons in the House of the Forest, and they tear down the houses of Samaria to strengthen the wall.
The Lord GOD of Hosts calls for weeping, but the people feast, and He says their sin will never be atoned for.
